sources.title: Communication Protocol for Energy Storage Inverters (RS485_MODBUS ESINV-33000ID Hybrid Inverter)
sources.note: Sections 5.1 (function 0x04, registers 25000 to 36999) and 5.2 (functions 0x03, 0x06, 0x10, registers 43000 to 44999)

notes: Covers Solis hybrid and energy storage inverters (the S5-EH1P and later generations; some registers apply only to the S6 generation or to models with a backup port, as the descriptions say). Grid-connected string inverters have a separate document and map.

Addresses are the decimal numbers of the manual and are sent as they are (address_base 0). Input registers (25000 to 36999) are read with function 0x04; setting registers (43000 to 44999) with 0x03, 0x06 and 0x10. Registers a model does not implement read 0.

32-bit values (U32, S32) use two registers with the high word first (big word order). Slave address 1, 9600 baud, no parity, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit by default; Modbus TCP on port 502 (one connection) on models with a LAN port.
The query interval must be above 300 ms and the control interval above 700 ms; only one write per frame (use function 0x06).

These tables were read from the manual's table layout; scale and unit come from the unit column (for example 0.1 V). The appendices (device type codes, national standard codes, alarm codes, status bits, battery model numbers, control switch states) and the application chapters (frequency control ancillary service, EMS) are not mapped, so values that refer to them are raw codes.
Some registers have remarks spanning several rows in the manual; the description is attached to the first row it covers.
